newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. Council condemns Mostar shooting.
newsitem.headline: U.N. Council condemns Mostar shooting.

text.p: Security Council members on Tuesday "condemned in the strongest possible terms" the death of a civilian after Croat gunmen fired on Mulims in the Bosnian city of Mostar.
Council President Njuguna Mahahugu of Kenya said members believed that those responsible should be identified, arrested and brought to trial.
"The council appeals to all responsible citizens in Mostar to remain calm and to maintain peace," he said in a statement after an informal council meeting.

The attack on Monday was one of the worst in Bosnia since the 1995 Dayton, Ohio, peace accords and occurred after about 200 Moslems visited a cemetery on a religious holiday. One man was killed and 22 were wounded.
